Name: Colorful Rugs
Author: BrutalCleric
Description:
Several large colorful rugs. Got tired of the tiny rugs I kept getting, so decided to make bigger ones. This is my 1st Mod so please be gentle. Some of these rugs took hours to make. If you find any issues, I probably wont be much help but let me know anyway. I'm sure someone will know what to do. Thanks

Requires 
CustomFurniture

Installation:

1. Download file. 
2. Expand all and drop into Mods folder.

Downloads.Description: Extra large rugs. Must have custom furniture. Hopefully it works this time.
